caption:
Bilal built Credora, a loan pre-screening app. You enter your income, employment and loan details, a logistic regression model returns an approved or rejected prediction in seconds, and a loan officer does the final verification. FastAPI and PostgreSQL behind it. His first AI/ML project.

Live app (a student project, demo only): https://credora-fintech.web.app/

Send this to the friend who thinks machine learning starts with a GPU.
